scope: Interactive CLI and authenticated native HTTP client acceptance against one actual two-branch dynamic-plan wait set, using AgentService, a synthetic model peer and xlang3-backed SQLite.
verified_behavior: Actual AgentService execution creates two concurrently waiting nested agents under one durable root pause.
The actual xmind_cli process attaches with /watch and returns both nested questions, each with the exact owner plan identity.
The CLI submits one selected question with its owning plan revision and state sequence, then detaches while the sibling remains pending.
The same plan observation route rejects a request without bearer authentication.
The actual HTTP route refreshes the still-pending sibling, rejects a stale nested-plan state sequence with HTTP 409, and accepts the current CAS head.
A2A rejects a continuation that omits the request selector while both questions are pending; an already-answered request is rejected as stale.
The two original nested calls complete exactly once after one CLI answer and one HTTP answer.
The combined Release contracts preserve repository restart/partial-resume coverage and CLI per-plan request routing.
limits: Provider and answer fixtures are synthetic; no live model/provider behavior is claimed.
The CLI and HTTP client flows are tested; rendered browser flow and installed VS Code flow remain open.
Concurrent HTTP answer races, cancellation races, expiry/uncertainty and repeated-segment budget/context exhaustion remain unverified.
